mentions.name: Cobalt
mentions.description: An open-source app development platform and SDK for Kobo eReaders, enabling apps to run natively on the low-power Linux e-ink device (with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and long battery life on ~$100 hardware). It ships with example apps built on the SDK in the same repo, including an HN client, a ChatGPT client, a Claude Code permissions sidekick, an RSS reader, and games, so the device can substitute for a Mac and phone.
mentions.problem: The author has high myopia that is progressively getting worse and wants to live without a Mac and phone.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I have high myopia that is progressively getting worse so started working on building an app development platform for my Kobo eReader so that I can live without my mac and phone. https://github.com/BandarLabs/Cobalt

Have built the SDK and some apps like an HN Client, ChatGPT client, Claude Code permissions sidekick, RSS Reader, some games etc. (all in the same above repo)
mentions.author: thepoet
